title: Compact 'Chef Kit' onboarding for Console first-run and cost primer
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Build a lightweight, persona-driven onboarding pattern we’re calling 'Chef Kits' — a set of three tiny starter projects (Kit: Integrator, Kit: Product Maker, Kit: Ops) that scaffold a first successful run in the Console. Each kit bundles: a pre-seeded sandbox project, a short guided tour (3 steps), and an inline cost primer that estimates per-session and monthly costs based on a representative workload. Goal is to reduce time-to-first-success and educate users about cost trade-offs without overwhelming them. This ticket covers finalizing UX, high-fidelity mockups, prototype for moderated testing, and handoff notes for Engineering and PMs.
acceptance_criteria: Three distinct Chef Kits designed and documented: Integrator, Product Maker, Ops
High-fidelity Figma screens for empty-canvas entry, kit selector, and kit quick-run flow
Interactive prototype that demonstrates selecting a kit, running the sample workflow, and viewing the cost primer
A11y baseline: keyboard focus states + contrast checks for new components
Design spec with component variants and copy strings ready for dev handoff
PM and two engineers have reviewed and signed off on scope and telemetry hooks
decisions: Limit visible kits to 3 on first-run to avoid choice paralysis (decided after 6 moderated sessions)
Make cost primer opt-in by default but prominent during the quick-run flow to balance education vs cognitive load
Use existing Toast/Walkthrough components to ship faster; add a flag for progressive enhancement of a full guided tour
Store kit selection as a workspace preference for repeatability
